---
title: "About this example"
---

This site is an example of an Asta workspace, made with the [workspace skill](https://github.com/allenai/asta-plugins/blob/main/plugins/asta-tools/skills/workspace/SKILL.md) and rebuilt from each asta-plugins release, so that you can see what a research project's workspace looks like before starting your own. Its content is sample text with public references.

- **Its paper is paired with Overleaf.** [View it in Overleaf](https://www.overleaf.com/project/6ad3a5f38f722e2e09c9a8f9/share#a44d86bf6428da0098e082455586b759b61d54f5764c735f) (view only): co-authors edit it there, their edits come back to the workspace as pull requests, and merged changes are published to Overleaf. Overleaf sees only the [`paper` folder](https://github.com/allenai/asta-plugins/tree/main/examples/workspace/paper), so the paper keeps its own bibliography, copied from the project's.
- **Every pull request gets a preview**, with the paper's PDF and a What changed page. [The saved demo](demo/index.qmd) shows one, with edits to the paper and the literature review.
- **Its source** is [examples/workspace](https://github.com/allenai/asta-plugins/tree/main/examples/workspace) in asta-plugins.

To start your own, ask your agent, with the Asta plugins installed, to start a research project. The [workspace guide](https://github.com/allenai/asta-plugins/blob/main/plugins/asta-tools/skills/workspace/assets/DEVELOPER.md) covers previews, VS Code and the paper.
